text:
yvonne: Quick flag: nebula-tiny-q4 canary shows ~0.5% tool-invoke schema errors after yesterday's quant tweak. dash: https://dash.internal/runs/5012
peter: any sample payloads?
sam: grabbed a failed stream: tool output includes a base64 payload for `blob` field but it gets a `Invalid character` JSON parse when decoded. snippet ends like: `\"blob\": \"SGVsbG8sIHRoaXMgaXMgYSB...Q==\n` where `\n` splits across chunks and becomes `\\n` literal in the assembled string -> parse fails
yvonne: repro: streaming + kv-cache + long context (~900 tokens). ci-bot posted a quick repro: `curl -X POST https://canary.internal/invoke -d '{\"model\":\"nebula-tiny-q4\",\"stream\":true,\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"long\"}],\"tools\":[{\"id\":\"store_blob\",\"schema\":{}}]}'`
peter: root cause looks like our streaming chunker doesn't preserve semantics for base64 payloads when a linebreak is inserted for chunk boundaries. Some clients expect base64 to be strict with `=` padding; stray newline or `\\n` injection corrupts it.
sam: quick mitigation I tried: runtime sanitizer that collapses escaped-newline sequences inside base64-looking fields: `re.sub(r'\"blob\"\s*:\s*\"([A-Za-z0-9+/=\\n]+)\"', lambda m: '\"blob\":\"' + m.group(1).replace('\\n','') + '\"', s)`
ops-bot: note: two Dedicated tenants saw duplicate ingest when client retried after 400. ops recommends: (1) stop auto-retrying 4xx parse errors, (2) require idempotency_key for side-effecting tools.
yvonne: plan: (A) infra add pre-parse sanitizer for base64/newline collapse behind ff (peter) (B) kernel: avoid inserting debug linebreaks in base64 outputs (sam) (C) api: change retry policy and propose idempotency_key (yvonne+product) (D) eng-ml: add streaming fuzz test that injects linebreaks/pads into base64 at chunk boundaries (peter/sam)
ci-bot: created fuzz job: https://ci.internal/job/5012/base64-chunk-fuzz
deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout: runtime-base64-sanitize -> nebula canary at 5012345685, 5% -> 100% if green
sam: I'll open kernel PR and add tests. peter: please add retry-policy PR so we avoid duplicate side-effects.
peter: retry-policy PR: https://git.internal/infra/policies/pull/140 (WIP)
sam: kernel PR: https://git.internal/infra/kernels/pull/256 (WIP)
yvonne: thanks all. keeping this thread as the coordination point. ping me @yvonne for traces and tenant contact info.
